Head_and_Face: Head is elongated with prominent occipital bone and slight stop.
Ears are long, set low, and covered with silky fringing.
Eyes are almond-shaped and dark.
Body_and_Plumage: Long, fine, silky coat flowing from body with short hair on saddle area (lower back).
Coat colors include all hues: cream, red, black, brindle, parti-color.
Body is elegant and athletic with deep chest of large sighthound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and long with large feet.
Tail is set low, carried in ring curl, and well-feathered.
Gait is free, smooth, and elastic with characteristic springy stride.

Head_and_Face: Head is domed with pronounced occipital peak and deep stop.
Eyes are large, dark, and mournful with visible haw (red conjunctiva).
Ears are extremely long, low-set, velvety, and trailing well beyond muzzle.
Body_and_Plumage: Extremely short legs relative to long heavy body creating low-slung profile.
Coat is short, smooth, dense, and hard-textured.
Coloration is tricolor (black, tan, white) or bicolor (red, white).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are extremely short relative to body length.
Tail is moderately long, white-tipped, and carried saber-like.
Skin is loose and wrinkled throughout.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly long with slight dome and moderate stop.
Ears are long, rounded at tips, set low, and hang close to cheeks.
Eyes are large, round, brown or hazel, with gentle pleading expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, dense, hard-textured, and weather-resistant.
Coloration is tricolor (black saddle, tan head and legs, white collar and tail tip) or bicolor.
White tail tip is distinctive identifying feature.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and sturdy with round compact feet.
Tail is set moderately high, carried gaily, not curled over back.
Body is compact and muscular of medium hound proportions.

Head_and_Face: Head is narrow and long in proportion to body with prominent occipital peak.
Eyes are deep-set, dark brown or amber, with drooping lower lids showing visible haw.
Ears are extremely long, thin, velvety, and set very low, hanging well below jawline.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, dense, hard-textured.
Coloration is black-and-tan, liver-and-tan, or red.
Body is powerful and muscular with deep chest and loose skin throughout of large hound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are sturdy and muscular.
Tail is long, thick, and carried saber-like.
Skin texture is loose and wrinkled especially on head and neck.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly broad with moderate stop and medium-length square muzzle.
Ears are long, set low, and hang close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark brown and alert.
Body_and_Plumage: Blue-ticked (mottled) coat pattern: white ground heavily mottled with blue-grey creating overall blue appearance.
Additional markings include black spots on body and tan markings on head, chest, and legs.
Coat is short, glossy, and smooth.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is moderately long, set high, and carried saber-like.
Body is athletic and well-muscled of large hound proportions.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly broad with slight dome and moderate stop.
Ears are long, set low, velvety, and hanging well below jawline.
Eyes are dark brown with alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Black-and-tan coloration: glossy black body with rich tan markings on muzzle, cheeks, chest, legs, and ventral surface.
Two tan dots above eyes (eyebrows).
Coat is short, dense, hard-textured, and glossy.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is moderately long, set high, and carried saber-like.
Body is powerful and well-muscled of large hound proportions.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly broad with slight dome and moderate stop.
Ears are long, set moderately low, and hanging close to cheeks.
Eyes are large, brown, and alert with pleading expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, hard, dense, and glossy.
Coloration is typically tricolor (black, white, tan) with black saddle, white collar and legs, tan head.
Some individuals display red-and-white or blue-ticked patterns.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is set moderately high, carried gaily, and white-tipped.
Body is athletic and well-proportioned of large hound proportions.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and domed with moderate stop and medium-length square muzzle.
Ears are long, set moderately low, and hanging flat against cheeks.
Eyes are large, round, brown or hazel, with alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, hard, dense, and glossy.
Coloration is typically tricolor (black, white, tan) or bicolor (foxhound tan and white) with bold clear markings.
Body is powerful and well-muscled of large hound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is set high, carried gaily, and white-tipped.
Gait is free, powerful, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly broad with slight dome and moderate stop.
Ears are long, set moderately low, and hanging close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark brown with alert, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Solid rich red or red-and-tan coat coloration uniform across entire body.
Coat is short, smooth, glossy, and dense.
Solid red coloration distinguishes from other coonhound breeds.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is moderately long, set high, and carried saber-like.
Body is athletic and well-muscled of large hound proportions.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and narrow with slight dome and minimal stop.
Ears are small, thin, and set high, folding back against neck.
Eyes are dark, oval, and expressive with soft gaze.
Body_and_Plumage: Long, silky coat forming profuse fringes on hindquarters, tail, and neck.
Coat ranges from white, cream, tan, red, grey, to black, often with darker markings.
Body is elegant and athletic with deep narrow chest and distinctive roached back of very large sighthound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long, straight, and fine-boned with narrow feet.
Tail is long, feathery, and carried in low curve.
Gait is free, graceful, and powerful with exceptional speed.
